The issue here seems to be with how the power operation handles null values. Specifically, it appears that when performing the power operation on two DataFrames, if one of them contains null values, it does not correctly handle these cases.

Looking at the code snippet for the `_arith_op` method (5261-5266), we see that it calls `ops.fill_binop(left, right, fill_value)` to fill in null values. However, this may not be sufficient to properly handle all cases involving null values and power operations.

Consequently, the error demonstrated by the test is likely due to an issue with how the DataFrame class handles power operations on DataFrames containing null values.
